INTERFACE/GLUES/MODELS/UI_ALLIANCE/UI_AL.note: F-151 human character-select/create scene reads too zoomed out. THIS is the human scene, NOT UI_HUMAN: GlueParent.lua SetBackgroundModel() special-cases the name and redirects HUMAN -> UI_ALLIANCE\UI_Alliance.m2 (and ORC -> UI_HORDE), so UI_HUMAN.M2 is shipped but never loaded by any code path. Editing UI_HUMAN is inert — that mistake cost a client round trip (2026-09-30). Camera sits 4.36 from the origin where the character stands; 0.87 rad framed 4.06 world units across it, 0.60 frames 2.70 (-33%, character ~50% larger); 0.70/3.19 was tried first and was still too far out. Pure framing dial, no geometric risk in this direction — narrowing only ever adds coverage. Ladder at this camera distance: 0.80 = 3.69, 0.75 = 3.44, 0.70 = 3.19, 0.65 = 2.94, 0.60 = 2.70 (the value the pack's unused UI_Alliance2.m2 carries).
